title: Veiled Gaze
desc: Through visual illusion and suggestive gazes, this series explores the boundary between reality and fantasy. Surrealist imagery and dreamlike spaces invite viewers to look beyond the visible surface.
desczh: 以视觉错觉与充满暗示的凝视，探索现实与幻想之间微妙的边界。超现实的形象与梦境般的空间，邀请观者越过画面的表层，进入隐秘的情绪与心理世界。

title: Me and Family Members
desc: Parental guidance and the emotional support of pets become two parallel visual narratives. Armed centaurs embody justice and punishment; a mosaic-like work traces the intimacy of caring for animals.
desczh: 将父母的教育与宠物给予的情感支持转化为两条并行的视觉叙事。手持武器的半人马象征正义与惩戒，马赛克般的拼接作品则呈现照料宠物时建立的亲密关系。
medium: Oil painting, 2.5 × 3 m; mixed media, 20 × 20 cm × 64

title: They Stand Upon Our Heads
desc: A layered world gives physical form to social inequality. Luxurious figures occupy the upper space while submerged bodies support their weight below. The diagonal composition suggests the instability of this social structure.
desczh: 以分层的画面将社会不平等转化为可感知的重量：奢华的人物占据上方，沉入水中的身体在下方承担重压。倾斜的构图暗示这种社会结构的不稳定。

title: Alone Together
desc: Shared rooms, a crowded bar, a solitary bedroom and figures suspended in water examine emotional distance. These paintings reflect on exclusion, difference and the quiet alienation that can persist within a group.
desczh: 共享的空间、拥挤的酒吧、独处的卧室与水中的身影，组成关于情感距离的观察。作品探讨群体中的排斥、差异，以及身处人群时依然存在的孤独。

title: Family Tree
desc: A layered wall installation brings together portraits and symbolic objects to explore family, memory and personal growth. Fragments accumulate into a changing image of identity and belonging.
desczh: 由肖像与象征性物件构成的层叠墙面装置，围绕家族、记忆与个人成长展开。不同片段在聚合中形成关于身份与归属的图景。

title: The Mold of Time
desc: A laboratory-like installation examines the ecological consequences of planned obsolescence. Orange slices form the pages of a book, while accumulating mold becomes a material record of environmental damage over time.
desczh: 以实验室般的装置空间，回应计划性报废带来的生态代价。橙片构成书页，逐渐增长的霉菌成为物质性的时间记录，呈现环境在持续消耗中受到的损害。

title: The Process of Searching for Self
desc: Following a letter, a character passes through doors into different worlds. Each encounter changes her colors and materials. Returning to the beginning, she encounters her original self and the importance of remembering who she was.
desczh: 主人公循着一封信的指引，穿过一道道门，进入不同世界。每次相遇都改变了她的色彩与材质。最终回到起点，她与最初的自己重逢，也重新理解记住初心的意义。

title: Studies & Observations
desc: A selection of oil paintings, portraits, observational drawings and master studies. These works focus on the figure, expression, spatial depth and the possibilities of line and surface.
desczh: 油画、肖像、观察性素描与临摹习作选集。通过对人物、表情与空间层次的持续观察，探索线条与画面肌理的表现可能。
